description: Save statement settings (rounding unit, signatory details, company information used on the statement face).

rounding_off.description: Whole-unit value rounding. When true (the default), every figure is rounded to the presentation unit and each CA-read total (profit, total assets, equity and liabilities) equals the rounded exact figure. A computed "Rounding off" line under Other expenses is only the profit adjustment; remaining Balance-Sheet rounding is disclosed under reserves / other current assets. false renders exact two-decimal figures.

weighted_potential_equity_shares.description: Weighted average potential equity shares (dilutive — options, convertibles). ADDITIONAL shares from options/convertibles only — not the total diluted share count. Enter 0 if the company has none. Do not repeat the basic share count.

weighted_potential_equity_shares_py.description: Weighted average potential equity shares — previous year (dilutive). ADDITIONAL shares from options/convertibles only — not the total diluted share count. Enter 0 if the company has none. Do not repeat the basic share count.
